lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest concentration observed along the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal rows of primary blobs to form a matrix-like arrangement of anchor nodes on the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.
